course_title: Introduction to the OCP Solution Provider Program
course_subtitle: Learn how the OCP Solution Provider Program helps organizations bring recognized products, solutions, facilities, and services to the OCP market.
course_description_html:
The OCP Solution Provider Program helps organizations showcase products, solutions, facilities, and services that support the OCP ecosystem. This course introduces the program’s recognition paths, OCP Marketplace visibility, participation requirements, and agreements so you can understand how your organization can engage.


Click START COURSE or select a lesson below.

blocks.body_html:
There are several logos and certification marks OCP offers members who show expertise in designing, deploying, and optimizing scalable, energy-efficient data center infrastructures.

We award these specific attributes through our OCP Solution Provider Program.

This program enables members to position their products, solutions, facilities, and services to meet the growing OCP market opportunity.
Click the play icon to watch the video.

blocks.body_html: The OCP Solution Provider Program encompasses several sub-programs, including:

items_html: Participating in the OCP Marketplace.
Having products recognized as OCP Accepted™.
Having a data center facility self certified as OCP Ready™.
Having a product approved as OCP S.A.F.E.™ and/or becoming an approved Security Review Provider (SRP).
Becoming a host for an OCP Experience Center.

blocks.body_html: Let's take a look at how products, facilities, and services qualify to receive these logos and recognitions.

blocks.complete_hint: Complete the content above before moving on.

blocks.body_html: The OCP Marketplace is where vendors from across the OCP Community converge to offer a diverse variety of hardware products, solutions, facilities and services that adhere to the core tenets of OCP. The multi-vendor nature of the OCP Marketplace ensures access to a wide range of options, allowing potential adopters to tailor their infrastructure to meet their specific needs and preferences.

The OCP Marketplace consists of several sections, including: OCP Recognized Products, Chiplets, Integrated Solutions and Professional Services, OCP Ready™ Data Center Facilities, OCP Experience Centers, Edge Solutions, as well as a dedicated section for AI.

All listings on the OCP Marketplace are from approved OCP Solutions Providers and is a great place to see where contributions meet the market in the form of products, solutions, facilities, and services.

blocks.body_html:
The OCP Product Recognition Sub-Program acknowledges products that align with an OCP approved contribution, allowing our members to promote their products and association with the OCP. It also helps potential adopters identify approved products and suppliers which are aligned with OCP's approved contributions.

Recognized OCP products are OCP Accepted™. Which comes with its own logo issued by the OCP Foundation.

Click the card to learn more.

back.description_html:
1. Available to all OCP Members.

  2. Must be a member of the OCP Solution Provider Program.

  3. A product can be recognized as OCP Accepted™ if it complies with an approved OCP specification AND design files have been contributed using the Design Package Guidelines.

blocks.label: CONTINUE
blocks.complete_hint: Complete the content above before moving on.

blocks.body_html: To have a product recognized as OCP Accepted™, members must first submit the relevant collateral to the OCP Foundation team for review. This includes a product datasheet and/or a link to the product, along with an indication of the OCP-approved specification or contribution the product aligns with, as indicated in the OCP Contributions Database.

• The Foundation team reviews the collateral to determine if the product meets the requirements.

  • The Foundation team may reach out to the volunteer Project Leads for any clarifying questions or concerns about the qualifications of a product.

  • Some projects may require to be notified (or require additional information from the member) prior to the Foundation team issuing OCP Accepted™ recognition.

For OCP Inspired™

The Foundation team reviews the collateral to determine if the product meets the requirements. The Foundation team may reach out to the volunteer project leads for any clarifying questions or concerns about the qualifications of a product.

Some projects may require to be notified (or require additional information from the member) prior to the Foundation team issuing OCP Inspired™ recognition.

Once approved, members sign the relevant OCP Solution Provider and OCP Accepted™ Certification Mark Agreements and provide marketing collateral for the OCP Marketplace. Once the listing is live on the OCP Marketplace, the Foundation team will provide ongoing quarterly OCP Marketplace Analytics, as well as joint business development opportunities with the member.

blocks.body_html: The OCP S.A.F.E.™ Program is engineered to streamline security audits, providing a centralized framework to ensure conformance and reliability for device consumers. By reducing redundancy and overhead in security assessments, the program aims to foster greater confidence in the security posture of hardware and firmware components across the supply chain.

There are two groups of members involved in S.A.F.E.

Click each card to learn more.

front.description_html: OCP Security Review Providers

back.description_html:
Third party security firms who perform security assessments on device firmware.

They are approved by the OCP Security Project's OCP S.A.F.E.TM Program leads based on a set of requirements.
Members who have products with firmware they wish to have approved as OCP S.A.F.E.™

blocks.label: CONTINUE
blocks.complete_hint: Complete the content above before moving on.

blocks.body_html:
Device manufacturers and approved OCP Security Review Providers work together under the S.A.F.E. framework to produce short form security audits which are available alongside OCP S.A.F.E.™ approved devices on the OCP Marketplace.

Let's take a look at the process of achieving OCP S.A.F.E.™ recognition.

items_html: Members choose from a list of approved OCP Security Review Providers to conduct a security conformance review.
The device will be designated an OCP S.A.F.E.™ approved product and listed on the OCP Marketplace once the OCP SRP submits the security conformance report.

The OCP Foundation team will issue the appropriate OCP S.A.F.E.™ logos to use with the device and provide ongoing quarterly OCP Marketplace Analytics, as well as joint business development opportunities with the member.

lessons.title: OCP Ready™ Data Center Recognition Program

blocks.body_html: Colocation data center operators participating in the OCP Ready™ Data Center Recognition Program perform a detailed OCP Ready™ self assessment of their facilities to ensure they meet the rigorous standards and requirements set forth by the Data Center Facilities Project. Data Centers that meet the OCP Ready™ requirements and complete the process will receive an OCP Ready™ certification mark.
Click each step to learn how data centers are recognized as OCP Ready™.

items.description_html:
Members choose the data center site assessment that aligns with their data center design/specification and target market.

There are currently two versions of the site assessment:

  1. OCP Ready™ v2 for Hyperscale: For data centers catering to hyperscale operators, emphasizing site security, logistics, base building infrastructure, and MWs of power and cooling capacity for large-scale wholesale deployments.

  2. OCP Ready™ v1: For colocation data centers meeting OCP and industry best practices for high-density power, cooling, and physical infrastructure, optimized for OCP recognized hardware (e.g., Open Rack V2).

There is a site assessment required for each recognition:

  1. OCP Ready™ v2 for Hyperscale Data Center Site Assessment (Google Sheet) (Excel)

  2. OCP Ready™ v1 Data Center Site Assessment (Google Sheet) (Excel)
Potential members complete the site assessment and contact the OCP Ready™ Facilities Lead to review their submission and discuss next steps.
Once the OCP Ready™ Facilities Lead confirms the site assessment meets the requirements, they sign the required OCP Membership and Solution Provider agreements.

The member presents their completed data center site assessment to the Data Center Facility Community for final evaluation and approval.

The Data Center Facilities Project Leads, OCP Ready™ Facility Lead and the Foundation team are all involved in the approval of a data center.
Upon approval, the member executes the OCP Ready™ Certification Mark License Agreement and prepares promotional materials to be listed on the OCP Marketplace.
The member's data center is published on the OCP Marketplace, making it visible to a global audience.

The OCP Foundation team issues the OCP Ready™ logo and proof of self-certification, as well as ongoing quarterly OCP Marketplace Analytics and joint business development opportunities with the member.

blocks.body_html:
OCP Solution Providers are eligible to host an OCP Experience Center. The primary focus of an OCP Experience Center is to accelerate open innovation and facilitate the widespread adoption of OCP-recognized equipment. Serving as a cornerstone in OCP's strategy to penetrate emerging markets, OCP Experience Centers complement the OCP Ready™, Product Recognition, and OCP S.A.F.E.™ programs.

The target audience for these centers includes adopters and channel partners seeking firsthand experience with OCP hardware. OCP Experience Centers can provide in-person or virtual access designed to provide proof points around OCP solutions, gaining a deep understanding of the benefits offered by OCP recognized equipment.

OCP Solution Providers reach out to the Foundation team to discuss the potential options for becoming a host and the Foundation team determines the viability of the center.

While project leads are not involved in this process, they are welcome to recommend potential members, technology areas or locations to establish an OCP Experience Center.

You can view all current OCP Ready™ Data Centers and OCP Experience Centers using the map below.

embed.description: OCP Ready™ certified data center facilities provide colocation services capable of supporting higher density compute, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) workloads. OCP Experience Centers seed emerging markets by allowing potential adopters to see and understand OCP equipment, channel and system integrators to conduct presales and engineers to develop new pre-product concepts.

blocks.body_html:
To become an OCP Solution Provider, companies must enter into a formal Solution Provider Agreement with the Open Compute Project Foundation. This agreement outlines the terms of participation, including adherence to OCP’s licensing, contribution, and trademark usage policies.

Solution Providers may also seek recognition of their products that demonstrate alignment with OCP standards. This includes the OCP Accepted™ recognition, which applies to products that align to OCP contributions. For facilities, the OCP Ready™ logo recognizes that a data center meets OCP infrastructure and operational requirements.

Please don’t sign any agreements prior to a discussion with the OCP Foundation.

blocks.label: CONTINUE
blocks.complete_hint: Complete the content above before moving on.

blocks.heading_html: Solution Provider Fees

blocks.body_html:
For Silver, Gold or Platinum OCP members, the Solution Provider program is included as a benefit.

For Bronze level members, there is an annual fee of $5,000 USD per year, in addition to your annual membership fee.

For members of our OCP Startup program, the fee to join the Solution Provider program, including the Marketplace, is dependent on your company’s startup level. Additional details on the OCP Startup program can be found here.

The fees and benefits are listed on the OCP site.

Before we finish, let's recap what we've covered in this course.

Click the icons to uncover the key learnings.

items.title: OCP Marketplace
items.description_html: The OCP Marketplace is a hub where approved vendors offer a wide range of OCP-aligned products, solutions, and services to help adopters customize their infrastructure.

items.title: OCP Product Recognition
items.description_html: The OCP Product Recognition Sub-Program highlights products that align with OCP-approved contributions, helping members promote their offerings and guiding adopters toward trusted, recognized solutions.

items.title: OCP S.A.F.E.™ Program
items.description_html: The OCP S.A.F.E.™ Program simplifies security audits with a unified framework to ensure reliable, trusted hardware and firmware across the supply chain.

items.title: OCP Data Center Facilities Recognition
items.description_html: The OCP Ready™ and OCP Experience Center programs certify compliant data centers and provide spaces for adopters and partners to explore, validate, and accelerate adoption of OCP-recognized solutions.

items.title: Agreements & Fees
items.description_html: Becoming an OCP Solution Provider requires a formal agreement with the OCP Foundation, granting companies the ability to gain product or facility recognitions, with program fees varying by membership level.
